options.content:
Indicative mid-price gaps only. Not executable and not profit.

Pool-state duration counts visible slots, not a tradable window. Provider timestamps group observations; laptop receipt order is not trading latency. Variable Meteora fees are not modeled; unknown net gaps stay Not measured. Event-rate denominators include only observations with known fees.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.window_start_utc AS "time", r.run_id AS "Run", r.provider AS "Provider", r.window_end_utc AS "Window end", r.payload_bytes AS "Payload bytes", r.gaps AS "Gaps", r.stalls AS "Stalls", v.venue AS "Venue", COALESCE((r.updates_by_venue->>v.venue)::bigint,0) AS "Updates", round(COALESCE((r.updates_by_venue->>v.venue)::numeric,0)*60/NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.window_end_utc-r.window_start_utc),0),2) AS "Updates/min", r.evidence_kind AS "Evidence kind" FROM research.gap_runs r CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('Orca'),('Raydium'),('Meteora')) v(venue) ORDER BY r.window_start_utc,v.venue

panels.title: Indicative gap events per hour by token group and threshold (H2)

targets.rawSql: WITH groups AS (SELECT DISTINCT run_id,token_group FROM research.gap_observation_buckets), thresholds AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (5),(10),(25),(50)) t(threshold_bps)) SELECT r.window_start_utc AS "time",r.run_id AS "Run",g.token_group AS "Token group",t.threshold_bps AS "Threshold (bps)",count(e.start_slot) AS "Events",round(count(e.start_slot)*3600.0/NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.window_end_utc-r.window_start_utc),0),2) AS "Events/hour",r.evidence_kind AS "Evidence kind" FROM research.gap_runs r JOIN groups g ON g.run_id=r.run_id CROSS JOIN thresholds t LEFT JOIN research.gap_events e ON e.run_id=r.run_id AND e.token_group=g.token_group AND e.threshold_bps=t.threshold_bps GROUP BY r.run_id,r.window_start_utc,r.window_end_utc,r.evidence_kind,g.token_group,t.threshold_bps ORDER BY r.window_start_utc,g.token_group,t.threshold_bps

panels.title: Indicative cross-venue versus same-venue event rates (H1)

targets.rawSql: WITH obs AS (SELECT token_pair,venue_combination,sum(observations) AS n FROM research.gap_observation_buckets GROUP BY 1,2), ev AS (SELECT token_pair,CASE WHEN venue_a<=venue_b THEN venue_a||'/'||venue_b ELSE venue_b||'/'||venue_a END AS venue_combination,count(*) AS n FROM research.gap_events WHERE threshold_bps=10 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT o.token_pair AS "Token pair",o.venue_combination AS "Venues",CASE WHEN split_part(o.venue_combination,'/',1)=split_part(o.venue_combination,'/',2) THEN 'Same venue' ELSE 'Cross venue' END AS "Comparison",o.n AS "Observations",COALESCE(e.n,0) AS "10 bps events",round(COALESCE(e.n,0)*1000.0/NULLIF(o.n,0),3) AS "Events/1000 observations",'Indicative' AS "Evidence kind" FROM obs o LEFT JOIN ev e USING(token_pair,venue_combination) ORDER BY o.token_pair,o.venue_combination

panels.title: Indicative net gap heatmap by token pair and minute

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.minute_utc AS "time",m.token_pair AS "Token pair",m.venue_a||'/'||m.venue_b AS "Venues",round(m.median_net_bps_micro::numeric/1000000,3) AS "Median net gap (bps)",m.observation_count AS "Observations",m.excluded_stale_count AS "Excluded stale",m.evidence_kind AS "Evidence kind" FROM research.gap_minute_stats m ORDER BY m.minute_utc,m.token_pair,m.pool_a,m.pool_b

panels.title: Indicative event duration distribution by threshold

targets.rawSql: WITH bins AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('1 slot',1),('2 slots',2),('3-5 slots',3),('6+ slots',4)) b(label,sort)), thresholds AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (5),(10),(25),(50)) t(threshold_bps)) SELECT t.threshold_bps AS "Threshold (bps)",b.label AS "Visible duration",count(e.start_slot) AS "Events",'Indicative' AS "Evidence kind" FROM thresholds t CROSS JOIN bins b LEFT JOIN research.gap_events e ON e.threshold_bps=t.threshold_bps AND (CASE WHEN e.duration_slots=1 THEN 1 WHEN e.duration_slots=2 THEN 2 WHEN e.duration_slots BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END)=b.sort WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM research.gap_observation_buckets) GROUP BY t.threshold_bps,b.label,b.sort ORDER BY t.threshold_bps,b.sort

panels.title: Indicative volatility and post-move event rates (H3, H4)

targets.rawSql: WITH exposure AS (SELECT 'H3 volatility' AS hypothesis,volatility_bucket AS cohort,sum(observations) AS n FROM research.gap_observation_buckets GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'H4 sharp move',CASE WHEN after_sharp_move THEN 'after sharp move' ELSE 'baseline' END,sum(observations) FROM research.gap_observation_buckets GROUP BY 1,2), events AS (SELECT 'H3 volatility' AS hypothesis,COALESCE(volatility_bucket,'Not measured') AS cohort,count(*) AS n FROM research.gap_events WHERE threshold_bps=10 GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'H4 sharp move',CASE WHEN after_sharp_move THEN 'after sharp move' ELSE 'baseline' END,count(*) FROM research.gap_events WHERE threshold_bps=10 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT x.hypothesis AS "Hypothesis",x.cohort AS "Cohort",x.n AS "Observations",COALESCE(e.n,0) AS "10 bps events",round(COALESCE(e.n,0)*1000.0/NULLIF(x.n,0),3) AS "Events/1000 observations",'Indicative' AS "Evidence kind" FROM exposure x LEFT JOIN events e USING(hypothesis,cohort) ORDER BY x.hypothesis,x.cohort

panels.title: Indicative top pool pairs by 10 bps event rate

targets.rawSql: WITH obs AS (SELECT m.pool_a,m.pool_b,m.token_pair,sum(m.known_fee_observation_count) AS n FROM research.gap_minute_stats m GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING sum(m.known_fee_observation_count)>0), ev AS (SELECT e.pool_a,e.pool_b,e.token_pair,count(*) AS n FROM research.gap_events e WHERE e.threshold_bps=10 GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT o.token_pair AS "Token pair",o.pool_a AS "Pool A",o.pool_b AS "Pool B",o.n AS "Observations",COALESCE(e.n,0) AS "10 bps events",round(COALESCE(e.n,0)*1000.0/NULLIF(o.n,0),3) AS "Events/1000 observations",'Indicative' AS "Evidence kind" FROM obs o LEFT JOIN ev e USING(pool_a,pool_b,token_pair) ORDER BY "Events/1000 observations" DESC,o.token_pair,o.pool_a,o.pool_b LIMIT 20
